The '''District Attorney''' ('''D.A.''') is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
The D.A. has been investigating [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski]], and Tenpenny orders [[Carl Johnson]] to pose as a valet at the [[Vank Hoff Hotel]], where the D.A. is staying, and plant [[Weed|marijuana]] in the trunk of his [[Merit|car]]. When the attorney arrives back at his car, Carl calls [[San Fierro Police Department|We Tip]] to report the D.A. The police arrive and, after searching his car, arrest him.

==Character==
===Appearance===
The D.A. does not have a unique model, and instead uses a generic [[Pedestrians|pedestrian]] model.
